theme: Lantern Requiem: a curved procession of five glass lanterns pulled from Soot's hand into the guard's near surface.

roles.shape: Local hand glint and original hanging lantern motif.
Curved double luminous cord; staggered lanterns along its path.
Five outlined lantern bodies with pointed roofs, ribbed panes and tassels; torn flowing light ribbons behind.
Asymmetric gold/violet shards directed into the target near surface.
Ground paint and separate floating pane fragments.

staging: All precontact geometry clipped at moving near-side front; faces drawn over effects. Focus affects opaque brightness. No camera motion.
capture: Capture canvas and actual audio gain output in one MediaRecorder, preserving actual stream timestamps. Burn a diagnostic scene clock in the study HUD.
